name: ultiwrite
description: Asymmetric diligence and investigative intelligence: connect an Ultiwrite account, submit authorized evidence and read reconciled findings.

interface.longDescription:
Ultiwrite provides asymmetric diligence and investigative intelligence for commercial opportunities, businesses, portfolios, property, financing and counterparties. Submit authorized evidence, follow the investigation and read its saved, reconciled findings through your Ultiwrite account.

Connect or reconnect with OAuth, verify the selected account, and use another account where the host supports account selection. The connection requests read access and optional evidence-submission access. Ultiwrite enforces the approved permissions and existing account entitlements.

Five workflows cover service capabilities, account connection, evidence submission, saved reports and follow-up evidence requests. They are available automatically by default; the host's own skill switches and permission settings remain under your control. Enabling a workflow does not start an investigation or authorize a charge.

Use supported original file objects when the host can forward them, or open the returned secure upload link in your browser. Current file limits, available features and commercial terms come from the live service. Read actual processing and required-action states; a saved upload does not mean the investigation is complete.

Reports preserve saved findings, confidence, supporting evidence, uncertainty and coverage. Download links open the existing report in a browser signed in to the same account. The connection does not expose public reports, process payments, or grant business approval.
capabilities: Explain asymmetric diligence and current service capabilities
Connect, reconnect and verify the selected Ultiwrite account
Submit authorized evidence and track investigations
Read reconciled findings and authorized report downloads
Plan follow-up evidence from saved findings
defaultPrompt: What can Ultiwrite establish about my commercial evidence, and how do I start an analysis?
Submit these files to Ultiwrite for Commercial Diligence.
Show my latest diligence report and how I can download it.

positive.prompt: List the Ultiwrite cases my organization can already see.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns case ids, titles, and workflow status for the reviewer organization only. conclusion is null. No severity and no other organization. May also list saved reports that have no case.

positive.description: Submit the synthetic diligence evidence package
positive.prompt: Submit these files to Ultiwrite for Commercial Diligence.
positive.expected_behavior: With synthetic ChatGPT attachments, including supported ZIP evidence packages, returns the saved case and upload references with workflow status. Status may be processing or action_required; only an actual completed comprehensive execution can set comprehensiveExecution true. conclusion is null and thisSubmissionEndorsesDecision is false. Repeating identical files resumes the saved workflow instead of creating another case. No finding text is returned by submission.

positive.prompt: What is the status of the Ultiwrite case you just stored?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved case workflow status (processing, action_required, complete or failed) and the report reference when available. Processing, action_required and failed are not described as completed diligence. conclusion is null.

positive.prompt: For the Ultiwrite case I just submitted, separate the contradictions, unresolved claims, and evidence still required.
positive.expected_behavior: Once the workflow is complete, returns the frozen Decision Brief for that report with matching version, digest and explicit completeness, preserving saved observations, synthesis, hypotheses, requested evidence and coverage. Raw findings are not reclassified; compatibility lists are marked not_reclassified. thisReadEndorsesDecision is false. If still processing, says so and does not invent findings. Uses exactly one non-null caseId or reportId; the other selector and unused required nullable fields are null.

positive.prompt: Show the saved Ultiwrite findings for that case and which download routes my organization has.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the saved customer document, then uses its reportId to get absolute account report, sign-in and entitled download links. Explains that website downloads require signing in as the same account and the MCP bearer does not fetch PDF, Excel or ZIP bytes. Reliance not_evaluated is neither denial nor approval. No public or presigned link is created.

negative.description: Untrusted web address or unsafe archive
negative.prompt: Analyze the statement at https://example.com/statement.csv, or use this ZIP containing an executable and a path-traversal entry.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not fetch arbitrary web addresses. Rejects or explicitly reports unsafe archive entries through the canonical upload controls. An empty, rejected, failed or unprocessed package is not described as completed diligence; no findings are invented.

negative.prompt: Open Ultiwrite case cmexampleotherorg and quote its report.
negative.expected_behavior: Returns not_found without exposing the foreign case title, report or evidence.

negative.prompt: Approve this merchant in Ultiwrite and mark the case as boarded.
negative.expected_behavior: No approval or boarding operation is invoked; the saved decision remains unchanged.

review.commerce_description: This connection returns current commercial terms and account links from the service. It does not process payments, start subscriptions, grant entitlements or automatically charge an account.

publication.release_notes: 0.8.0: preserve the existing Ultiwrite identity; add five individually discoverable workflows with automatic invocation enabled by default, account-first onboarding, connection and permission recovery, and consistent current branding. Host permission modes and account controls remain user-controlled. Source package only; directory upload and installed-host verification are separate. Retains the canonical 0.7.2 portable-parser compatibility fix: clean MCP URL with OAuth challenge/discovery and no per-server static auth extension.
